1→// lifecycle.go implements the generic lifecycle event dispatcher.
     2→// It routes normalized events from any agent to the appropriate framework actions.
     3→//
     4→// The dispatcher inverts the current flow from "agent handler calls framework functions"
     5→// to "framework dispatcher calls agent methods." Agents are passive data providers;
     6→// the dispatcher handles all orchestration: state transitions, strategy calls,
     7→// file change detection, metadata generation.

    29→// DispatchLifecycleEvent routes a normalized lifecycle event to the appropriate handler.
    30→// Returns nil if the event was handled successfully.
    31→func DispatchLifecycleEvent(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
    32→	if ag == nil {
    33→		return errors.New("agent cannot be nil")
    34→	}
    35→	if event == nil {
    36→		return errors.New("event cannot be nil")
    37→	}
    38→
    39→	switch event.Type {
    40→	case agent.SessionStart:
    41→		return handleLifecycleSessionStart(ctx, ag, event)
    42→	case agent.TurnStart:
    43→		return handleLifecycleTurnStart(ctx, ag, event)
    44→	case agent.TurnEnd:
    45→		return handleLifecycleTurnEnd(ctx, ag, event)
    46→	case agent.Compaction:
    47→		return handleLifecycleCompaction(ctx, ag, event)
    48→	case agent.SessionEnd:
    49→		return handleLifecycleSessionEnd(ctx, ag, event)
    50→	case agent.SubagentStart:
    51→		return handleLifecycleSubagentStart(ctx, ag, event)
    52→	case agent.SubagentEnd:
    53→		return handleLifecycleSubagentEnd(ctx, ag, event)
    54→	default:
    55→		return fmt.Errorf("unknown lifecycle event type: %d", event.Type)
    56→	}
    57→}

    59→// handleLifecycleSessionStart handles session start: shows banner, checks concurrent sessions,

    61→func handleLifecycleSessionStart(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
    62→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
    63→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session-start",
    64→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
    65→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
    66→		slog.String("session_ref", event.SessionRef),
    67→		slog.String("model", event.Model),
    68→	)
    69→
    70→	if event.SessionID == "" {
    71→		return fmt.Errorf("no session_id in %s event", event.Type)
    72→	}
    73→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(event.SessionID); err != nil {
    74→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s event: %w", event.Type, err)
    75→	}
    76→
    77→	// Build informational message
    78→	message := "\n\nPowered by Entire:\n  This conversation will be linked to your next commit."
    79→
    80→	// Check for concurrent sessions and append count if any
    81→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
    82→	if count, err := strat.CountOtherActiveSessionsWithCheckpoints(ctx, event.SessionID); err == nil && count > 0 {
    83→		message += fmt.Sprintf("\n  %d other active conversation(s) in this workspace will also be included.\n  Use 'entire status' for more information.", count)
    84→	}
    85→
    86→	// Output informational message if the agent supports hook responses.
    87→	// Claude Code reads JSON from stdout; agents that don't implement
    88→	// HookResponseWriter silently skip (avoids raw JSON in their terminal).
    89→	if event.ResponseMessage != "" {
    90→		message = event.ResponseMessage
    91→	}
    92→	if writer, ok := ag.(agent.HookResponseWriter); ok {
    93→		if err := writer.WriteHookResponse(message); err != nil {
    94→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to write hook response: %w", err)
    95→		}
    96→	}
    97→
    98→	// Fire EventSessionStart for the current session (if state exists).
    99→	if state, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, event.SessionID); loadErr != nil {
   100→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load session state on start",
   101→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))
   102→	} else if state != nil {
   103→		persistEventMetadataToState(event, state)
   104→		if transErr := strategy.TransitionAndLog(ctx, state, session.EventSessionStart, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); transErr != nil {
   105→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "session start transition failed",
   106→				slog.String("error", transErr.Error()))
   107→		}
   108→		if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, state); saveErr != nil {
   109→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to update session state on start",
   110→				slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()))
   111→		}
   112→	}
   113→
   114→	return nil
   115→}

   156→// handleLifecycleTurnEnd handles turn end: validates transcript, extracts metadata,
   157→// detects file changes, saves step + checkpoint, transitions phase.
   158→//
   159→//nolint:maintidx // high complexity due to sequential orchestration of 8 steps (validation, extraction, file detection, filtering, token calc, step save, phase transition, cleanup) - splitting would obscure the flow
   160→func handleLifecycleTurnEnd(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   161→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   162→	logging.Info(logCtx, "turn-end",
   163→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   164→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   165→		slog.String("session_ref", event.SessionRef),
   166→		slog.String("model", event.Model),
   167→	)
   168→
   169→	sessionID := event.SessionID
   170→	if sessionID == "" {
   171→		sessionID = unknownSessionID
   172→	}
   173→
   174→	transcriptRef := event.SessionRef
   175→	if transcriptRef == "" {
   176→		return errors.New("transcript file not specified")
   177→	}
   178→	if !fileExists(transcriptRef) {
   179→		return fmt.Errorf("transcript file not found: %s", transcriptRef)
   180→	}
   181→
   182→	// Early check: bail out quickly if the repo has no commits yet.
   183→	if repo, err := strategy.OpenRepository(ctx); err == nil && strategy.IsEmptyRepository(repo) {
   184→		logging.Info(logCtx, "skipping checkpoint - will activate after first commit")
   185→		return NewSilentError(strategy.ErrEmptyRepository)
   186→	}
   187→
   188→	// Create session metadata directory
   189→	sessionDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   190→	sessionDirAbs, err := paths.AbsPath(ctx, sessionDir)
   191→	if err != nil {
   192→		sessionDirAbs = sessionDir
   193→	}
   194→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDirAbs, 0o750); err != nil {
   195→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   196→	}
   197→
   198→	// If agent implements TranscriptPreparer, wait for transcript to be ready
   199→	if preparer, ok := ag.(agent.TranscriptPreparer); ok {
   200→		if err := preparer.PrepareTranscript(ctx, transcriptRef); err != nil {
   201→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to prepare transcript",
   202→				slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   203→		}
   204→	}
   205→
   206→	// Copy transcript to session directory
   207→	transcriptData, err := ag.ReadTranscript(transcriptRef)
   208→	if err != nil {
   209→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read transcript: %w", err)
   210→	}
   211→	logFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.TranscriptFileName)
   212→	if err := os.WriteFile(logFile, transcriptData, 0o600); err != nil {
   213→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write transcript: %w", err)
   214→	}

   216→		slog.String("path", sessionDir+"/"+paths.TranscriptFileName))
   217→

   219→	preState, err := LoadPrePromptState(ctx, sessionID)
   220→	if err != nil {
   221→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load pre-prompt state",
   222→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   223→	}
   224→
   225→	// Determine transcript offset
   226→	transcriptOffset := resolveTranscriptOffset(ctx, preState, sessionID)
   227→
   228→	// Compute subagents directory for agents that support subagent extraction.
   229→	// Subagent transcripts live in <transcriptDir>/<modelSessionID>/subagents/
   230→	subagentsDir := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(transcriptRef), event.SessionID, "subagents")
   231→
   232→	// Extract metadata via agent interface (prompts, summary, modified files)
   233→	var allPrompts []string
   234→	var summary string
   235→	var modifiedFiles []string
   236→
   237→	if analyzer, ok := ag.(agent.TranscriptAnalyzer); ok {
   238→		// Extract prompts
   239→		if prompts, promptErr := analyzer.ExtractPrompts(transcriptRef, transcriptOffset); promptErr != nil {
   240→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract prompts",
   241→				slog.String("error", promptErr.Error()))
   242→		} else {
   243→			allPrompts = prompts
   244→		}
   245→
   246→		// Extract summary
   247→		if s, sumErr := analyzer.ExtractSummary(transcriptRef); sumErr != nil {
   248→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract summary",
   249→				slog.String("error", sumErr.Error()))
   250→		} else {
   251→			summary = s
   252→		}
   253→
   254→		// Extract modified files - prefer SubagentAwareExtractor if available to include subagent files
   255→		if subagentExtractor, subOk := ag.(agent.SubagentAwareExtractor); subOk {
   256→			if files, fileErr := subagentExtractor.ExtractAllModifiedFiles(transcriptData, transcriptOffset, subagentsDir); fileErr != nil {
   257→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract modified files (with subagents)",
   258→					slog.String("error", fileErr.Error()))
   259→			} else {
   260→				modifiedFiles = files
   261→			}
   262→		} else {
   263→			// Fall back to basic extraction (main transcript only)
   264→			if files, _, fileErr := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(transcriptRef, transcriptOffset); fileErr != nil {
   265→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract modified files",
   266→					slog.String("error", fileErr.Error()))
   267→			} else {
   268→				modifiedFiles = files
   269→			}
   270→		}
   271→	}
   272→
   273→	// Write prompts file
   274→	promptFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)
   275→	promptContent := strings.Join(allPrompts, "\n\n---\n\n")
   276→	if err := os.WriteFile(promptFile, []byte(promptContent), 0o600); err != nil {
   277→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write prompt file: %w", err)
   278→	}
   279→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "extracted prompts",
   280→		slog.Int("count", len(allPrompts)),
   281→		slog.String("path", sessionDir+"/"+paths.PromptFileName))
   282→
   283→	// Write summary file
   284→	summaryFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.SummaryFileName)
   285→	if err := os.WriteFile(summaryFile, []byte(summary), 0o600); err != nil {
   286→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write summary file: %w", err)
   287→	}
   288→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "extracted summary",
   289→		slog.String("path", sessionDir+"/"+paths.SummaryFileName))
   290→
   291→	// Generate commit message from last prompt
   292→	lastPrompt := ""
   293→	if len(allPrompts) > 0 {
   294→		lastPrompt = allPrompts[len(allPrompts)-1]
   295→	}
   296→	commitMessage := generateCommitMessage(lastPrompt, ag.Type())
   297→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "using commit message",
   298→		slog.Int("message_length", len(commitMessage)))
   299→
   300→	// Get worktree root for path normalization
   301→	repoRoot, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(ctx)
   302→	if err != nil {
   303→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get worktree root: %w", err)
   304→	}
   305→
   306→	var preUntrackedFiles []string

   312→
   313→	// Detect file changes via git status
   314→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(ctx, preUntrackedFiles)
   315→	if err != nil {
   316→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to compute file changes",

   318→	}

   320→	// Filter and normalize all paths
   321→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   322→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   323→	if changes != nil {
   324→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)

   326→
   327→		// Merge git-status modified files as a fallback for transcript parsing.
   328→		// Transcript parsing is the primary source for modified files, but it can miss
   329→		// files if the agent uses an unrecognized tool or the transcript format changes.

   331→		relModifiedFiles = mergeUnique(relModifiedFiles, FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Modified, repoRoot))

   335→	// When an agent commits files mid-turn, those files are condensed by PostCommit

   338→	relModifiedFiles = filterToUncommittedFiles(ctx, relModifiedFiles, repoRoot)

   416→// handleLifecycleCompaction handles context compaction: saves current progress
   417→// but stays in ACTIVE phase (unlike TurnEnd which transitions to IDLE).
   418→// Also resets the transcript offset since the transcript may be truncated.
   419→func handleLifecycleCompaction(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   420→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   421→	logging.Info(logCtx, "compaction",
   422→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   423→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   424→	)
   425→
   426→	// Fire EventCompaction to trigger ActionCondenseIfFilesTouched (stays in ACTIVE)
   427→	sessionID := event.SessionID
   428→	sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   429→	if loadErr != nil {
   430→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load session state for compaction",
   431→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))
   432→	}
   433→	if sessionState != nil {
   434→		if transErr := strategy.TransitionAndLog(ctx, sessionState, session.EventCompaction, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); transErr != nil {
   435→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "compaction transition failed",
   436→				slog.String("error", transErr.Error()))
   437→		}
   438→
   439→		if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, sessionState); saveErr != nil {
   440→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to save session state after compaction",
   441→				slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()))
   442→		}
   443→	}
   444→
   445→	logging.Info(logCtx, "context compaction detected")
   446→	return nil
   447→}

   449→// handleLifecycleSessionEnd handles session end: marks the session as ended.
   450→func handleLifecycleSessionEnd(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   451→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   452→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session-end",
   453→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   454→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   455→	)
   456→
   457→	if event.SessionID == "" {
   458→		return nil // No session to update
   459→	}
   460→
   461→	// Note: We intentionally don't clean up cached transcripts here.
   462→	// Post-session commits (carry-forward in ENDED phase) may still need
   463→	// the transcript to extract file changes. Cleanup is handled by
   464→	// `entire clean` or when the session state is fully removed.
   465→
   466→	if err := markSessionEnded(ctx, event.SessionID); err != nil {
   467→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to mark session ended",
   468→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   469→	}
   470→	return nil
   471→}

   473→// handleLifecycleSubagentStart handles subagent start: captures pre-task state.
   474→func handleLifecycleSubagentStart(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   475→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   476→	logging.Info(logCtx, "subagent started",
   477→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   478→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   479→		slog.String("tool_use_id", event.ToolUseID),
   480→		slog.String("transcript", event.SessionRef),
   481→	)
   482→
   483→	// Capture pre-task state
   484→	if err := CapturePreTaskState(ctx, event.ToolUseID); err != nil {
   485→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to capture pre-task state: %w", err)
   486→	}
   487→
   488→	return nil
   489→}

   491→// handleLifecycleSubagentEnd handles subagent end: detects changes, saves task checkpoint.
   492→func handleLifecycleSubagentEnd(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   493→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   494→	if event.SubagentType == "" && event.TaskDescription == "" {
   495→		// Extract subagent type and description from tool input
   496→		event.SubagentType, event.TaskDescription = ParseSubagentTypeAndDescription(event.ToolInput)
   497→	}
   498→
   499→	// Determine subagent transcript path
   500→	transcriptDir := filepath.Dir(event.SessionRef)
   501→	var subagentTranscriptPath string
   502→	if event.SubagentID != "" {
   503→		subagentTranscriptPath = AgentTranscriptPath(transcriptDir, event.SubagentID)
   504→		if !fileExists(subagentTranscriptPath) {
   505→			subagentTranscriptPath = ""
   506→		}
   507→	}
   508→
   509→	// Log context
   510→	subagentEndAttrs := []any{
   511→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   512→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   513→		slog.String("tool_use_id", event.ToolUseID),
   514→	}
   515→	if event.SubagentID != "" {
   516→		subagentEndAttrs = append(subagentEndAttrs, slog.String("agent_id", event.SubagentID))
   517→	}
   518→	if subagentTranscriptPath != "" {
   519→		subagentEndAttrs = append(subagentEndAttrs, slog.String("subagent_transcript", subagentTranscriptPath))
   520→	}
   521→	logging.Info(logCtx, "subagent completed", subagentEndAttrs...)
   522→
   523→	// Extract modified files from subagent transcript
   524→	var modifiedFiles []string
   525→	if analyzer, ok := ag.(agent.TranscriptAnalyzer); ok {
   526→		transcriptToScan := event.SessionRef
   527→		if subagentTranscriptPath != "" {
   528→			transcriptToScan = subagentTranscriptPath
   529→		}
   530→		if files, _, fileErr := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(transcriptToScan, 0); fileErr != nil {
   531→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract modified files from subagent",
   532→				slog.String("error", fileErr.Error()))
   533→		} else {
   534→			modifiedFiles = files
   535→		}
   536→	}
   537→
   538→	// Load pre-task state and detect file changes
   539→	preState, err := LoadPreTaskState(ctx, event.ToolUseID)
   540→	if err != nil {
   541→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load pre-task state",
   542→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   543→	}
   544→	var preUntrackedFiles []string
   545→	if preState != nil {
   546→		preUntrackedFiles = preState.PreUntrackedFiles()
   547→	}
   548→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(ctx, preUntrackedFiles)
   549→	if err != nil {
   550→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to compute file changes",
   551→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   552→	}
   553→
   554→	// Get worktree root and normalize paths
   555→	repoRoot, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(ctx)
   556→	if err != nil {
   557→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get worktree root: %w", err)
   558→	}
   559→
   560→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   561→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   562→	if changes != nil {
   563→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)
   564→		relDeletedFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Deleted, repoRoot)
   565→		relModifiedFiles = mergeUnique(relModifiedFiles, FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Modified, repoRoot))
   566→	}
   567→
   568→	// If no changes, skip
   569→	if len(relModifiedFiles) == 0 && len(relNewFiles) == 0 && len(relDeletedFiles) == 0 {
   570→		logging.Info(logCtx, "no file changes detected, skipping task checkpoint")
   571→		_ = CleanupPreTaskState(ctx, event.ToolUseID) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup
   572→		return nil
   573→	}
   574→
   575→	// Find checkpoint UUID from main transcript (best-effort)
   576→	var checkpointUUID string
   577→	// Use the existing CLI-level checkpoint UUID finder
   578→	mainLines, _ := parseTranscriptForCheckpointUUID(event.SessionRef) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort
   579→	if mainLines != nil {
   580→		checkpointUUID, _ = FindCheckpointUUID(mainLines, event.ToolUseID)
   581→	}
   582→
   583→	// Get git author
   584→	author, err := GetGitAuthor(ctx)
   585→	if err != nil {
   586→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   587→	}
   588→
   589→	// Build task checkpoint context
   590→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
   591→	agentType := ag.Type()
   592→
   593→	taskStepCtx := strategy.TaskStepContext{
   594→		SessionID:              event.SessionID,
   595→		ToolUseID:              event.ToolUseID,
   596→		AgentID:                event.SubagentID,
   597→		ModifiedFiles:          relModifiedFiles,
   598→		NewFiles:               relNewFiles,
   599→		DeletedFiles:           relDeletedFiles,
   600→		TranscriptPath:         event.SessionRef,
   601→		SubagentTranscriptPath: subagentTranscriptPath,
   602→		CheckpointUUID:         checkpointUUID,
   603→		AuthorName:             author.Name,
   604→		AuthorEmail:            author.Email,
   605→		SubagentType:           event.SubagentType,
   606→		TaskDescription:        event.TaskDescription,
   607→		AgentType:              agentType,
   608→	}
   609→
   610→	if err := strat.SaveTaskStep(ctx, taskStepCtx); err != nil {
   611→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save task step: %w", err)
   612→	}
   613→
   614→	_ = CleanupPreTaskState(ctx, event.ToolUseID) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup
   615→	return nil
   616→}

   618→// --- Helper functions ---
   619→
   620→// resolveTranscriptOffset determines the transcript offset to use for parsing.
   621→// Prefers pre-prompt state, falls back to session state.
   622→func resolveTranscriptOffset(ctx context.Context, preState *PrePromptState, sessionID string) int {
   623→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle")
   624→	if preState != nil && preState.TranscriptOffset > 0 {
   625→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "pre-prompt state found, parsing transcript from offset",
   626→			slog.Int("offset", preState.TranscriptOffset))
   627→		return preState.TranscriptOffset
   628→	}
   629→
   630→	// Fall back to session state
   631→	sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   632→	if loadErr != nil {
   633→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load session state",
   634→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))
   635→		return 0
   636→	}
   637→	if sessionState != nil && sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart > 0 {
   638→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "session state found, parsing transcript from offset",
   639→			slog.Int("offset", sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart))
   640→		return sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart
   641→	}
   642→
   643→	return 0
   644→}

   646→// createContextFile creates a context.md file for the session checkpoint.
   647→// This is a unified version that works for all agents.
   648→func createContextFile(contextFile, commitMessage, sessionID string, prompts []string, summary string) error {
   649→	var sb strings.Builder
   650→
   651→	sb.WriteString("# Session Context\n\n")
   652→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Session ID: %s\n", sessionID)
   653→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Commit Message: %s\n\n", commitMessage)
   654→
   655→	if len(prompts) > 0 {
   656→		sb.WriteString("## Prompts\n\n")
   657→		for i, p := range prompts {
   658→			fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "### Prompt %d\n\n%s\n\n", i+1, p)
   659→		}
   660→	}
   661→
   662→	if summary != "" {
   663→		sb.WriteString("## Summary\n\n")
   664→		sb.WriteString(summary)
   665→		sb.WriteString("\n")
   666→	}
   667→
   668→	if err := os.WriteFile(contextFile, []byte(sb.String()), 0o600); err != nil {
   669→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write context file: %w", err)
   670→	}
   671→	return nil
   672→}

   674→// parseTranscriptForCheckpointUUID is a thin wrapper around transcript parsing for checkpoint UUID lookup.
   675→// Returns parsed transcript lines for use with FindCheckpointUUID.
   676→func parseTranscriptForCheckpointUUID(transcriptPath string) ([]transcriptLine, error) {
   677→	lines, err := transcript.ParseFromFileAtLine(transcriptPath, 0)
   678→	if err != nil {
   679→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing transcript for checkpoint UUID: %w", err)

   684→// transitionSessionTurnEnd transitions the session phase to IDLE and dispatches turn-end actions.
   685→func transitionSessionTurnEnd(ctx context.Context, sessionID string, event *agent.Event) {
   686→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle")
   687→	turnState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   688→	if loadErr != nil {
   689→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load session state for turn end",
   690→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))
   691→		return
   692→	}
   693→	if turnState == nil {
   694→		return
   695→	}
   696→
   697→	persistEventMetadataToState(event, turnState)
   698→
   699→	if err := strategy.TransitionAndLog(ctx, turnState, session.EventTurnEnd, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); err != nil {
   700→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "turn-end transition failed",
   701→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   702→	}
   703→
   704→	// Always dispatch to strategy for turn-end handling. The strategy reads
   705→	// work items from state (e.g. TurnCheckpointIDs), not the action list.
   706→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
   707→	if err := strat.HandleTurnEnd(ctx, turnState); err != nil {
   708→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "turn-end action dispatch failed",
   709→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   710→	}
   711→
   712→	if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, turnState); updateErr != nil {
   713→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to update session phase on turn end",
   714→			slog.String("error", updateErr.Error()))
   715→	}
   716→}

   718→// markSessionEnded transitions the session to ENDED phase via the state machine.
   719→func markSessionEnded(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
   720→	state, err := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   721→	if err != nil {
   722→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   723→	}
   724→	if state == nil {
   725→		return nil // No state file, nothing to update
   726→	}
   727→
   728→	if transErr := strategy.TransitionAndLog(ctx, state, session.EventSessionStop, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); transErr != nil {
   729→		logging.Warn(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), "session stop transition failed",
   730→			slog.String("error", transErr.Error()))
   731→	}
   732→
   733→	now := time.Now()
   734→	state.EndedAt = &now
   735→
   736→	if err := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, state); err != nil {
   737→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   738→	}
   739→	return nil
   740→}
